**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

When approaching the [Angel Cave](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/zion-canyon?locationIds=485545) for the first time, a tribesman named Two-Bears-High-Fiving will rush out and gesture towards the player.

His name is a reference to the player base believing that one of the ink blots Doc Mitchell shows at the start of the game looks an awful lot like two bears high fiving - and creating a mod to let you answer as such.
